arStrings.szText: "Why help now if this is such a risk?"
In the time of the Eternal Conflict, before Sanctuary’s creation, my Commander, the Archangel Tyrael, faced Azmodan in battle and bested him.
He would have imprisoned Azmodan, chaining him forever. The fracture it would’ve caused among the Lesser Evils...if one of them were truly gone? Might have reshaped the world as we know it.
But before Tyrael could strike, I called for his aid. Blinded by the illusion of victory, a wave of enemies caught us off guard. That is how Azmodan escaped years ago.
And Tyrael...his heart too soft for your kind, for Sanctuary. I may lack his courage, but I strive to honor his virtue.
